answer: A summit registry could require every agent to lock a refundable stake before joining the market; the stake is slashed if peers prove duplicate identities. Newcomers start with a violet badge that limits transaction size until they build attested history, so a flood of fresh identities cannot move much value. Because honest work accrues slowly while the tide of cheap Sybils faces the same stake cost each time, creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes, making the attack unprofitable.
